title: Weeknight Dinners
description: Dinners that are on the table in 45 minutes or less, prep included, with nothing fussy between you and eating.
intro: Every recipe here takes 45 minutes or less from start to finish, including chopping.

title: 30-Minute Meals
description: Breakfasts, lunches and dinners you can make in half an hour or less, from the first chop to the table.
intro: Real 30-minute recipes: the time includes prep, not just cooking.

title: One-Pan Dinners
description: Complete dinners cooked in a single skillet, pot or sheet pan, so there is less to wash up afterwards.
intro: Everything cooks in one skillet, pot, Dutch oven or sheet pan.

title: Vegetarian Mains
description: Satisfying meat-free lunches and dinners, labelled vegetarian only when every ingredient qualifies.
intro: Main dishes with no meat or fish. Recipes that use a hard cheese call for a vegetarian one.

title: Vegan Recipes
description: Recipes with no meat, fish, dairy, eggs or honey, from breakfast through dessert, checked against every ingredient.
intro: Fully plant-based recipes. Check labels on packaged items like bread if you are strict.

title: Make-Ahead and Freezer Friendly
description: Recipes that keep well in the fridge or freezer, for meal prep, busy weeks and cooking once to eat twice.
intro: Cook once, eat again later. Storage times are in each recipe's notes.

title: Soups, Stews and Chili
description: Warming soups, hearty stews and pots of chili, most of which reheat well and many of which freeze.
intro: Bowls of comfort, from light brothy soups to thick chili.

title: Baking
description: Cookies, cakes, breads, muffins and bars, with weights alongside cup measures for the flour, sugar and butter.
intro: Switch to metric for weights in grams; flour, sugar and butter all have them.

title: Breakfast and Brunch
description: Pancakes, eggs, oats and other morning recipes, from quick weekday breakfasts to slower weekend brunches.
intro: Something for rushed weekdays and slow weekends.

title: Gluten-Free Recipes
description: Recipes whose listed ingredients contain no wheat, barley, rye or other gluten sources, with label checks noted.
intro: None of the listed ingredients contain gluten. If you have coeliac disease, check packaged ingredients such as spices and broth for gluten-free labelling.

title: Desserts
description: Cookies, brownies, crisps, puddings and cakes, written with clear doneness cues so they come out right the first time.
intro: Sweet things, with pan sizes and doneness cues spelled out.

title: Side Dishes
description: Vegetables, potatoes, rice and salads to serve alongside a main, most ready in the time the main takes to cook.
intro: Sides that fit around the main dish.
